items.title: TSMC Revenue Hits Record NT$514.8B, Up 53.3%
items.author: Elias Virtanen
items.highlights: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company posted its highest monthly revenue in company history on September 11, 2026, and the number tells a bigger story than one good month. TSMC booked NT$514.81 billion in August sales, up 10.1% from July and 53.3% higher than the same month a year earlier, according to company figures cited by industry briefing 01.co’s The Blade. It was the first time TSMC’s monthly revenue broke the NT$500 billion mark, and the fourth consecutive month the company set a new record. ... The timing matters. items.highlights: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE: TSM) delivered its fifth consecutive quarterly revenue record in Q2 2026, posting consolidated net revenue of NT$1,270.38 billion (approximately US$40.2 billion), representing 36.0% year-over-year growth and 12.0% sequential expansion. Net income surged 77.4% year-over-year to NT$706.56 billion, with diluted earnings per share reaching NT$27.25 (US$4.31 per ADR unit).
